title: StackChan auto-dance firmware with expressions, RGB lighting and servo motion

source.source_delivery: standalone Arduino sketch in this record

checks.name: boot_marker
checks.detail: StackChan auto-dance started observed on UART0

checks.name: servo_sync_write
checks.detail: Derived summary reported 1006 SCSCL SYNC_WRITE packets to address 42; raw trace was not retained for independent recount

checks.name: rgb_lighting
checks.detail: 1367 RGB buffer refreshes and 32808 M5IOE1 RGB register writes

checks.name: stability
checks.detail: over 90 seconds and 5 loops; no fatal trace markers

checks.name: physical_hardware
checks.detail: no physical StackChan was connected or operated

notes: The first candidate exposed a UART spinlock assertion under continuous acknowledged servo writes.
The final firmware uses broadcast SCSCL SYNC_WRITE and does not wait for per-servo acknowledgements.
Virtual-device PASS does not establish physical torque, current, brightness, acoustics or optics.
The recorded source was rebuilt successfully, but the full BIN SHA-256 is not bit-reproducible across source paths because Arduino/ESP-IDF embed build metadata.
